The Danish Siddiqui Journalism Scholarship is an annual initiative of the Danish Siddiqui Foundation aimed at supporting aspiring journalists at the postgraduate level. The scholarship is awarded to individuals who demonstrate a strong commitment to ethical journalism and storytelling grounded in truth, empathy, and integrity.

Recipients are selected based on their academic promise, journalistic potential, and dedication to covering issues that matter. The scholarship provides financial support and access to mentorship opportunities, helping students pursue their education and develop impactful journalism projects.
Through this initiative, the foundation seeks to invest in the next generation of journalists who will uphold the values of responsible and courageous reporting.
For an enriching learning experience, the foundation provides support and professional guidance to each scholar during the duration of the study.

I began my journey in journalism as a young woman from Varanasi with a dream to make a difference. But the realities of newsrooms, gatekept spaces, and the growing challenges of the profession left me questioning my future. I almost gave up, yet journalism never left me. Pursuing a Master's in Mass Communication kept that passion alive. Receiving the Danish Siddiqui Foundation Scholarship was a turning point. It offered not just financial support, but mentorship, validation, and hope. Today, I look forward to continuing my work with the Foundation, especially on the vital issue of journalist safety.

Receiving the Danish Siddiqui Foundation Scholarship is an incredible honour and a deeply meaningful milestone in my journey. Knowing how competitive the selection process was makes this recognition even more special. I am sincerely grateful to the selection committee for believing in my work, and to my professors, friends, and family for their constant encouragement and support. I look forward to developing my project under this year's theme, Journalists' Safety, and contributing meaningfully to conversations around protecting those who dedicate their lives to reporting the truth.

Receiving the Danish Siddiqui Foundation Scholarship is a privilege and an honour. It inspires me to contribute towards creating a safer and more supportive environment for journalists. Danish Siddiqui's courage and commitment to fearless reporting continue to motivate aspiring journalists like me. Being selected for this scholarship is not only a recognition of my potential but also a responsibility to carry forward his legacy of truth, integrity, and public interest journalism. I look forward to pursuing meaningful work under the Foundation's guidance and contributing to the ongoing conversation around journalist safety.

The Danish Siddiqui Foundation Scholarship has strengthened my commitment to fact-based and data-driven journalism. More than financial support, it serves as a source of motivation, encouraging me to sharpen my journalistic skills and pursue meaningful, public interest reporting. I believe this scholarship will inspire aspiring journalists to uphold the values of truth, integrity, and accountability, using their words, voices, and stories to serve society. I am grateful to be part of a community united by purpose, driven by ideas, and committed to carrying forward Danish Siddiqui's legacy of courageous journalism.

Beyond financial support, it is a meaningful recognition of my commitment to ethical and impactful journalism. Answers to common queries that will help you while applying for the scholarship program.
Who is eligible for the scholarship?
Preference will be given to applicants from economically weaker sections (income less than Rs. 3,50,000) who've secured admission in a Masters journalism degree course at a government college.
Scholarships will be awarded on the basis of academic merit and financial needs. The decision made by the selection panel will be considered final.
What is the duration of the scholarship award?

The Scholarship is for one (1) year with an extension to the second year of study, as appropriate on a case to case basis, conditional on maintaining satisfactory performance. Maximum duration is two (2) years.
When is the deadline for submission?
You can send applications once you've secured admission in the college. The submission deadline is March 31 every year.
Can I apply to more than one college?
Yes. You may apply to more than one college simultaneously. However, you should mention this in the application form.
